title: Point-in-Time Enterprise Financial Risk Data Contract

firm_id.description: Cryptographically masked, irreversible pseudonymous borrower identifier.

source_id.description: Registered unique identifier of data provider and stream.

event_id.description: Globally unique, deterministic identifier of observation event.

timestamp_obs.description: Timestamp when the economic event occurred or account state was observed.

timestamp_pub.description: Timestamp when the source provider published the record or finalized the tape.

timestamp_avail.description: Timestamp when the data became queryable in the risk database. T_avail >= T_pub >= T_obs.

timestamp_ingest.description: Timestamp when record was physically written to internal data lake landing zone.

reporting_period.format: YYYY-MM or YYYY-Q# or YYYY-W## or integer T
reporting_period.description: Standardized accounting or economic reporting interval identifier.

currency.description: Denomination currency for monetary metrics. Null for dimensionless ratios.

scale_factor.description: Multiplicative scaling factor applied to metric_value (e.g. 1000.0 for thousands).

is_imputed.description: True if value was statistically imputed; False if raw observation.

data_provenance.description: Complete cryptographic audit trail of data lineage.

pseudonymous_identity_mapping_protocol.algorithm: HMAC-SHA256 with 256-bit cryptographically secure secret salt
pseudonymous_identity_mapping_protocol.salt_storage: Enterprise Hardware Security Module (HSM) / Azure Key Vault / AWS KMS
pseudonymous_identity_mapping_protocol.salt_rotation_policy: Annual rotation with deterministic legacy versioning
pseudonymous_identity_mapping_protocol.isolation_mandate: Direct legal identifiers (Tax ID, Company Name, LEI) strictly barred from risk feature store and research workspaces.
entity_resolution_rules: Exact match on Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) where available
Deterministic national registration number hash match
Fuzzy text matching on entity names strictly prohibited to prevent misattribution

point_in_time_enforcement_invariants: INVARIANT_PREDICTION_CUTOFF: Feature x valid at T_pred iff T_avail(x) <= T_pred
INVARIANT_VINTAGE_SELECTION: For revised macro series, MacroValue(t; T_pred) = Vintage(t, max{T_release <= T_pred})
INVARIANT_NO_FUTURE_PROXY: Zero synthesis or lookahead imputation permitted
